changes: Added a real InitialHarbor PlayMode fixture using SaveSystem.NewGame, the D29 preparation/shipyard Buttons, the D9 Repair/Close Buttons, and the public D3/D4 owner state.
Covered D9 repair success, material shortage, same-frame repeated repair with unchanged money/hull/material, same saveRevision domain idempotency, page cancel and primary-input restoration.
Covered D4 shipyard success, insufficient-money rejection, and a fault-injected owner exception through D29's real recovery path; the test restores the original owner after the exception branch.
Fixed a real D29 UI defect: owner availability refresh no longer overwrites the latest success/rejection/exception feedback before the player can read it.

checks.name: d9_preparation_repair_success
checks.evidence: Q17_SHIPYARD_PREPARATION_PLAYMODE_R5.xml; real D9 Repair Button changed hull by exactly 10, deducted 80 money and consumed one timber; log contains preparation_success=true.

checks.name: repair_material_shortage_rejection
checks.evidence: The real D9 Repair Button with empty timber inventory kept money and hull unchanged and returned feedback containing 木材; log contains repair_reject_material=true.

checks.name: repair_repeat_and_domain_idempotency
checks.evidence: Repeated repair after a full hull kept money/hull/material unchanged; the same D9 saveRevision returned duplicate_settlement with no second mutation; log contains repair_duplicate_unchanged=true and domain_duplicate_idempotent=true.

checks.name: cancel_and_busy_recovery
checks.evidence: The real D9 Close Button hid the page and restored RuntimeHudCoordinator.PrimaryInputAllowed; rejection and exception branches also restored primary input. Log contains cancel_recovery=true and primary_input_restored=true.

checks.name: d4_shipyard_success_and_rejection
checks.evidence: The real D29 Shipyard Button advanced D4 Hull upgrade exactly one level with sufficient money/reputation; insufficient money left the level unchanged, closed the empty page, and displayed the rejection. Log contains shipyard_success=true and shipyard_reject=true.

checks.name: exception_feedback_and_recovery
checks.evidence: The test temporarily nulls the existing D4 shipyard owner to trigger the real D29 catch/recovery path; money and level stayed unchanged, the temporary page closed, and status contained 请求异常. Log contains exception_recovery=true.

checks.name: feedback_persistence_fix
checks.evidence: R4 exposed D29.RefreshButtonAvailability overwriting the successful shipyard feedback with 交互入口已就绪; the D29 _hasActionFeedback fix was followed by R5 1/1 PASS with the success, rejection and exception assertions intact.

checks.name: dependent_d29_regression
checks.evidence: After the D29 feedback fix, Q15_PANEL_FOCUS_PLAYMODE_R6.xml and Q16_TRADE_BRIDGE_PLAYMODE_R3.xml each passed 1/1; the combined Whalebone.Tests.D29 run Q17_D29_REGRESSION_PLAYMODE_R1.xml passed 3/3 in one Unity process. Their result JSON files contain current-source revalidation entries.

failed_attempts.reason: The D16 PlayMode test assembly does not reference Gameplay/UI or Agent assemblies; the fixture was changed to use reflection for Gameplay owner types, matching Q15/Q16.
The fixture treated D9's _panel controls object as a canvas root and searched for D9PortServiceControls/Repair; it was corrected to search the actual controls children.
D4 shipyard reputation is owned by D4FactionSystem rather than GameState.CurrentPlayer.Reputation; the fixture now arranges the real D4 faction owner.
D29 availability refresh overwrote the latest shipyard success feedback on the following frame; D29 now preserves action feedback, and R5 revalidated the complete route.

remaining_scope: This closes the bounded D29/D9/D4 preparation and shipyard logic/feedback routes only; it does not prove native Windows Player screenshots, mouse hit testing, performance, or complete voyage/Continue flow.
Q03 remains BLOCKED_ASSET for imported-rig action quality, so the user's task-animation distortion still needs valid current-rig action assets/adapter and native visual recheck.
Q04/Q05 prove the code-level swimming state/motion boundary, but the native Player ocean visual and control experience still requires VC-G01-NATIVE evidence.
VC-G01 remains IN_PROGRESS; VC-G02/VC-G03 remain LOCKED and D31-P04/D31-S05/D31-G06 remain PARTIAL.
status_boundary: Q17 VERIFIED means the tested D29/D9/D4 owner bridges produced the tested success/rejection/duplicate/cancel/exception state and feedback results in real InitialHarbor PlayMode. It is not a final game or D31 acceptance pass.
